transcript.text: I still think about that Shanghai trip in 2025—everyone kept hyping up the food scene there.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Getting there was a whole story too—I was coming from Beijing to Shanghai, and it felt like half my office was on the same route.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And yeah, the hotel situation in Shanghai was fine in the end, but I remember we compared a bunch of places back then.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For the flight, my coworker had already booked me on China Eastern—flight MU5678—for 2025-03-13, under Zhang Wei, so I didn’t touch any of it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The hotel was also handled without me—Hanting Hotel People's Square, check-in was 2025-03-19 for 3 nights, and it was under Chen Ming.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Dinner one night was a big group thing—Chuanfu Laozao on 2025-03-04 at 18:00, party size 8. Totally not my planning, I just showed up.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I remember the reservation details because they texted them around—Wang Fang was the contact, phone 13864788741, and she kept reminding us it was for 8. Also, random side note: I even stopped by a pharmacy for some medicine that trip, nothing dramatic.

intent.ambiguity_notes: Weak/negative intent: user is reminiscing about a completed 2025 Shanghai trip; all bookings were already made by others and no help is requested.
